host_scope: RTX 4060 Laptop GPU / sm_89 / WSL2 only

authority.owner_direction: Continue to the next stage and do not perform SHA verification.
authority.scope: Select among existing lm_head paths and decide whether any custom kernel has measured method-value; do not implement a custom candidate.

carrier.mirror_policy: One unregistered BF16 CUDA copy of the tied CPU lm_head weight; original CPU Parameter identity, embedding tie, state_dict, and device map must not change.

authenticity.consumer: greedy token argmax in the formal C02 PyTorch replay path

correctness.real_states: Capture the last hidden state for every one of the 11 frozen prompt prefills and the immediately following first decode step generated by the same-load CPU reference, for 22 states total.
correctness.reference: CPU tied BF16 lm_head followed by tanh(logits/30)*30 and argmax
correctness.hard_gate: Every eligible CUDA baseline returns the exact reference token ID on all 22 real states.
correctness.raw_argmax_boundary: Raw-logit argmax is diagnostic only even if all 22 samples match; finite-precision softcap can create ties and may not be removed without a full deployment-equivalence gate.

baselines.cpu_tied_softcap_argmax: Current formal path; CPU BF16 Linear over the tied weight, BF16 softcap, then argmax.
baselines.cuda_eager_softcap_argmax: Unregistered BF16 CUDA mirror with torch.nn.functional.linear, softcap, and argmax.
baselines.cuda_compile_softcap_argmax: torch.compile(fullgraph=true, mode=reduce-overhead, dynamic=false) around the same CUDA mirror operation.
baselines.cuda_eager_raw_argmax: Diagnostic softcap-elision comparator; never best-baseline eligible in R1.
baselines.cuda_compile_raw_argmax: Compiled diagnostic softcap-elision comparator; never best-baseline eligible in R1.
baselines.best_baseline_rule: Choose the lower p50 of the two correctness-eligible softcap-preserving CUDA paths.

analytic_bytes.tier: Tier-A compulsory bytes for a token-only fused consumer
analytic_bytes.formula: BF16 weight + BF16 hidden input + int64 token output

measurement.gpu_interleave: four-way rotation by repetition index across the 22 real hidden states

selection_gate.authenticity: PASS only for the exact OP1 census population and observed tied CPU implementation.
selection_gate.bottleneck: PASS only if the best correctness-eligible CUDA softcap path has Tier-A relative score <=0.80 against the same-day ceiling.
selection_gate.existing_path_precedence: If a softcap-preserving CUDA mirror path is exact on all 22 states, at least 1.50x faster than the CPU formal path, and stays below 7.5 GiB, authorize its separate C02 reconnection probe before any custom kernel.
selection_gate.custom_candidate_authorization: Only Authenticity PASS + Bottleneck PASS after existing-path precedence may authorize a separately preregistered custom design.
selection_gate.if_bottleneck_fails: Do not implement a custom lm_head kernel; retain the valid negative method-value result.
selection_gate.if_existing_path_is_eligible: Freeze a separate same-load full C02 A/B reconnection protocol for the existing CUDA mirror path; this selection alone is not deployment authorization.

replacement_checks: required input presence and model manifest byte sizes
direct Parameter, tied-storage, state_dict, NF4 topology, device-map, memory, and telemetry checks

non_authorizations: custom candidate implementation unless custom_path is selected
board, llama.cpp, sm_100, or sm_120 extrapolation
